{{verse|chapter=18|verse=24}} And a certaine Iew, named {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Apollo.}}∷ Apollo, borne at Alexandria, an eloquent man, came to Ephe{{ls}}us, mighty in the {{ls}}criptures. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=25}} This man was taught the vvay of our Lord: and being feruent in {{ls}}pirit he {{ls}}pake, and taught diligently tho{{ls}}e things that pertaine to {{sc|Iesvs}}, knovving only the bapti{{ls}}me of Iohn. {{verse|chapter=18|verse=26}} This man therfore began to deale confidently in the {{ls}}ynagogue.
